entities.name: Query protein P2 capsid
observations: 269 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 30.2 kDa and theoretical pI 6.85.
Exact full-length sequence match to UniProt P15794, the reviewed Pseudoalteromonas phage PM2 major capsid protein P2.
Pfam domains P2_N (PF18628) span residues 6–134 and P2_C (PF25513) span residues 153–264.
Reference annotation assigns virion localization, homotrimeric assembly, and major capsid function.

entities.name: P15794 major capsid P2
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference for Pseudoalteromonas phage PM2 major capsid protein P2.
Exact sequence identity and 100% query/target coverage to the analyzed sequence; E-value 1.78e-193.
Localized to the virion and forms a homotrimer.
Annotated with GO:0098017, viral capsid major subunit.

entities.name: Viral capsid
observations: The analyzed protein is the major structural capsid subunit of Pseudoalteromonas phage PM2 virions.
